result.design_intent: The design aims to showcase a curated collection of simple, fast weeknight recipes with clear categorization and visual hierarchy, making it effortless for users to browse and select dishes based on prep time, difficulty, and serving size.

key_components.name: Navigation Bar
key_components.role: Provides brand identity and site-wide navigation links.
key_components.notable_styling: Features the 'Saffron Kitchen' logo on the left with an orange circular mark, and clean sans-serif text links for 'Recipes', 'Seasonal', and 'About' aligned to the right.

key_components.name: Header Section
key_components.role: Introduces the page context and offers interactive filtering capabilities.
key_components.notable_styling: Includes a small orange category kicker, a large serif heading ('Everyday recipes, beautifully simple.'), a descriptive subtitle, and a row of pill-shaped filter buttons with 'All' highlighted in orange.

key_components.name: Recipe Card Grid
key_components.role: Displays six distinct recipe cards in a three-column grid layout.
key_components.notable_styling: Each card has rounded corners, a colored header image area containing an abstract plate illustration, a category label in orange, a serif recipe title, a short description, and a bottom metadata row displaying time, difficulty, and serving size with icons.

key_components.name: Footer
key_components.notable_styling: Subtle muted text split into copyright on the left and tagline on the right, separated by a thin horizontal border rule.

result.layout_summary: The layout features a light cream-colored page with a top navigation bar, a header section introducing 'Six weeknight favourites' with category filter pills, a 3x2 grid of recipe cards featuring custom vector plate illustrations, and a minimal footer.
implementation_risks: Ensuring the 3x2 grid correctly wraps and maintains equal card dimensions across different screen sizes.
Precise spacing and alignment of the inline metadata icons and text within the recipe cards.
Handling the pill filter buttons to support an active state (orange background) versus inactive states (transparent background with soft border).
Maintaining consistent border-radius and overflow clipping on the recipe cards so the colored header illustrations align cleanly with the card edges.

visual_comparison.summary: The implementation deviates from the design by missing the category filter buttons ('All', 'Breakfast', 'Main', 'Dessert', 'Vegan') entirely, and the subtitle text below the main heading is different ('Delicious recipes for everyone to enjoy at home.' instead of 'Six tested dishes from our kitchen — each one under an hour, with ingredients you already have.'). Additionally, there are height and spacing discrepancies due to these missing and altered elements.

findings.title: Category filter buttons are missing
findings.evidence: The production screenshot lacks the pill-shaped category buttons shown in the Figma reference between the intro text and the recipe cards.
findings.description: The Figma design includes a row of filter buttons ('All', 'Breakfast', 'Main', 'Dessert', 'Vegan') beneath the intro description, but the production page completely omits them.

findings.title: Incorrect subtitle text
findings.evidence: Comparing the subtitle under 'Everyday recipes, beautifully simple.', the production text is shorter and reads differently than the Figma reference.
findings.description: The subtitle text under the main heading is incorrect in production. It shows 'Delicious recipes for everyone to enjoy at home.' instead of the expected 'Six tested dishes from our kitchen — each one under an hour, with ingredients you already have.'

violations.description: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds

accessibility_interpretation.summary: The web page has a moderate accessibility posture with a single distinct violation related to color contrast across seven elements. While it does not outright break functionality, it creates significant visual barriers for users with low vision or when viewing the page in suboptimal lighting conditions.

most_important_issues.user_impact: Text across seven elements fails to meet minimum contrast standards against its background, making it difficult or impossible for users with visual impairments to read content comfortably.
